press_references.value: Sharkup Launches UAE’s First Fully Digital Business Setup Platform for Entrepreneurs in Dubai

product_launches.description: Sharkup launched a fully digital business setup platform that enables end-to-end online company formation, compliance, and banking support for entrepreneurs in Dubai.

overview_description.description:
Overview:

Sharkup is the UAE's pioneering digital platform for company incorporation, dedicated to simplifying the trade license acquisition process for entrepreneurs. Founded by a seasoned startup consultant with over seven years of experience in the Middle East, Sharkup leverages cutting-edge technology to provide a seamless and efficient solution for business setup in the UAE.

Mission:

Our mission is to revolutionize the company formation process by transitioning to a fully digital world, making it easier, faster, and more accessible for entrepreneurs to start and grow their businesses in the UAE.

Services:

Sharkup offers a comprehensive suite of services designed to meet the needs of entrepreneurs and businesses at every stage of their journey:

Digital Trade License Acquisition: Simplified, fast, and fully online process to obtain trade licenses.
Business Setup Consultation: Expert advice on corporate structuring, market entry strategies, and financial planning.
Free Zone and Mainland Setup: Assistance with choosing the right setup and location based on business requirements.
PRO Services: End-to-end support for all government-related processes and documentation.
Bank Account Opening: Facilitation of corporate bank account opening with leading banks in the UAE.
Founder:

Sharkup was founded by an experienced startup consultant who has worked closely with entrepreneurs, venture capitalists, and angel investors to build robust corporate structures in the UAE. With an MBA from the University of Greenwich, London, and a BMS from St. Xavier's College, Mumbai, the founder brings a wealth of knowledge and expertise to the company. They have successfully consulted on projects for Fortune 100 companies and notable crypto exchanges in the region.

Core Values:

Innovation: Continuously leveraging technology to enhance our services.
Integrity: Building long-term relationships based on trust and honesty.
Customer-Centricity: Ensuring our services bring happiness and satisfaction to our clients.
Excellence: Striving for the highest standards in all that we do.
Key Achievements:

UAE's first digital platform for securing trade licenses.
Successfully assisted numerous startups and businesses in establishing their presence in the UAE.
Played a crucial role in helping notable crypto exchanges lay their foundation in the Middle East.
